events.text: Persia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Patron of Weavers (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for each [ICON_RES_SILK] Silk, Dye, and [ICON_RES_COTTON] Cotton resource)

Carthage has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

Japan has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Voice of the Surf (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture from Atolls, and from [ICON_RES_FISH] Fish, [ICON_RES_WHALE] Whales, [ICON_RES_CRAB] Crab, [ICON_RES_PEARLS] Pearls, Red Caviar, and Caviar resources)
